Stockfish is distributed under the GNU General Public License version 3.

The worker image contains:

- The Stockfish executable at `/opt/stockfish/stockfish`.
- The corresponding pinned source archive at
  `/usr/share/doc/stockfish/stockfish-source.tar.gz`.
- The Stockfish license at `/usr/share/doc/stockfish/Copying.txt`.

The image build obtains the source archive from the official Stockfish
repository. The URL and SHA-256 digest are supplied through
`STOCKFISH_SOURCE_URL` and `STOCKFISH_SOURCE_SHA256` build arguments.

Official source repository:

https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish

Official license:

https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/blob/master/Copying.txt
